svg.title: A Rolling Aggregate mean with a window of 2 rows moves down the monthly table one row at a time. January has no earlier row, so its window is not full and the result is null. February averages 24 and 30 to 27, and March averages 30 and 30 to 30.
svg.text: the window moves down one row at a time
yellow = rows inside the window for that month
